name: openbb_forex_historical
description:
Daily exchange-rate history for one currency pair through the OpenBB Platform (obb.currency.price.historical).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points, start_date, end_date, rates: [{date, open, high, low, close}]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (six letters, e.g. EURUSD, GBPJPY; default EURUSD); start_date (default 90 days ago); end_date (default today); provider (fmp, polygon, tiingo, yfinance; default yfinance).
Other sources: yf_forex_history, av_forex_daily; current rate: av_forex_rate. Keys: yfinance needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; polygon, tiingo need a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "GBPJPY", "start_date": "2026-07-01"}
